chains.name: Harbour: CSMT–Panvel
notes: High-level Sandhurst Road chainage 1.80, different from Main 2.08. Ravli Junction RVJ is a cabin and excluded from passenger stations. Mansarovar 43.477 in 2024 (43.48 in 2019). Sanpada operational timetable alias SNPD; 2019 station map SNCR.

chains.name: Harbour: Wadala Road–Bandra
notes: 2024 CSMT-via-Harbour chainage Mahim12.47; 2019 map12.523. Continue BA→KHAR→STC→VLP→ADH→JOS→RMAR→GMN using Western graph edges, not CSMT-base subtraction. Harbour does not run through Dadar.

notes: DGHA printed in2024 engineeringmap; current operational timetable usesDIGH alias. RabaleRABE verified nationalstationregister row220.

chains.name: Trans-Harbour: Turbhe–Sanpada–Vashi
notes: Resolved viaThane labels using preserved horizontal positions in primarydocument mirror: Vashi28.89 atx230 with viaTNA51.52 atx244; Sanpada labelx263 with viaTNA50.381 atx278. Values are route-specific engineeringchainages. Original public HTML savedcr-map-2024-public.html.

chains.name: Trans-Harbour: Turbhe–Juinagar–Nerul
notes: Map explicitly prints Juinagar31.94 with viaTUH50.533 and Nerul34.47 with52.994viaTUH. Preserved horizontal positions in mirrorchecked, sourcechainagebasis viaThane/Turbhe. FollowNerul→PanvelHarbouredges; noVashi/Sanpadadetour.
